The analysis failed due to incorrect margin calculations and decision logic in the output data.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_rows_and_order and test_totals_and_decision. Specifically, close(302.4, 4536.0) returned False for program-level values, and total_annual_margin_10_day_usd failed with close(-61983.9, -79751.7). Avoid incorrect scaling or logic in the cost-benefit formulas, as the current implementation produced significant discrepancies in both individual program codes and aggregate totals.
